It’s a beautiful thing when a plan goes exactly as intended!

Mexican police apprehended:
✅ 3 smugglers (who will face criminal charges in #Mexico)
✅ 3 illegal aliens (who are being held as witnesses)

The #ElCentroSector apprehended:
✅ 1 cloned utility truck
✅ 1 illegal alien (who will face charges for 8 USC 1326: Re-entry of deported alien)

We use all options, including international teamwork, to keep our borders secure. We’re all in on our mission to safeguard the border.

💡DYK💡“Mirror patrol” = Law enforcement on both sides of the border move in sync toward one goal: stop crime before it crosses. 

#DHS #CBP #USBP #BorderPatrol #PremierSector
